EURUSD.architecture: three-member regularized XGBoost probability ensemble + Platt calibration
EURUSD.target_contract: Direction of executable move from next contiguous M5 open to close 30 minutes later.

split.rule: Chronological 60/15/10/5/10 split: TRAIN / VALIDATION / CALIBRATION / META / FINAL TEST, with a 30-minute target-horizon purge between partitions.

meta_partition.purpose: Reserved for cost-aware meta-label trade selection.
